methods.name: append
methods.summary: Appends an element (either null or non-null) to the struct. The actual elements should be appended for each child sub-array in a consistent way.

methods.name: append_non_nulls
methods.summary: Appends `n` non-null entries into the builder.

methods.name: append_null
methods.summary: Appends a null element to the struct.

methods.name: append_nulls
methods.summary: Appends `n` `null`s into the builder.

methods.name: as_any
methods.summary: Returns the builder as a non-mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: as_any_mut
methods.summary: Returns the builder as a mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: field_builder
methods.signature: fn field_builder<T: ArrayBuilder>(&mut self, i: usize) -> Option<&mut T>
methods.summary: Returns a mutable reference to the child field builder at index `i`. Result will be `None` if the input type `T` provided doesn't match the actual field builder's type.

methods.name: field_builders
methods.summary: Returns a reference to field builders

methods.name: field_builders_mut
methods.summary: Returns a mutable reference to field builders

methods.name: fields
methods.summary: Returns the fields for the struct this builder is building.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Builds the `StructArray` and reset this builder.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Builds the array.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the `StructArray` without resetting the builder.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the array without resetting the builder.

methods.name: from_fields
methods.signature: fn from_fields(fields: impl Into<Fields>, capacity: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new `StructBuilder` from [`Fields`] and `capacity`

methods.name: into_box_any
methods.summary: Returns the boxed builder as a box of `Any`.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of array slots in the builder.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(fields: impl Into<Fields>, field_builders: Vec<Box<dyn ArrayBuilder>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new `StructBuilder`

methods.name: num_fields
methods.summary: Returns the number of fields for the struct this builder is building.

methods.name: validity_capacity
methods.summary: Returns the current null buffer allocated capacity, in bytes.

methods.name: validity_slice
methods.summary: Returns the current null buffer as a slice
